text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My mission.
To revitalize—the Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will fulfill it—without fail.
—I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
